description: Provider-neutral inventory of the runtime variables materially consumed at the FuFirE Engine/Uvicorn boundary. Secrets-free by construction: this file records names, ownership, required status, allowed shapes and readback policy — never a configured value. Provider-specific bindings (which platform supplies which value) live in the deployment, not here.

production.description: Fail-closed profile. Missing or unsafe values abort startup.

development.description: Permissive local profile. The documented dev-mode bypass stays available.

readback_policies.value: Non-secret and explicitly safe to echo verbatim in a readback.
readback_policies.presence: Only configured/valid booleans are emitted. No value, prefix, suffix or length.

value_normalizations.exact: Default for a row that declares no value_normalization. The whitespace-trimmed value is compared as-is, case-sensitively.
value_normalizations.lower: The whitespace-trimmed value is lower-cased before comparison. The row's value lists are declared in lower case.
value_normalizations.upper: The whitespace-trimmed value is upper-cased before comparison. The row's value lists are declared in upper case.

fail_closed_codes.reject_invalid_value: The consuming module raises on an unsupported value.
fail_closed_codes.none: Advisory or presentation-only; no fail-closed behaviour.

variables.name: FUFIRE_ENV
variables.description: Declares the deployment profile. Selects the fail-closed production contract.

variables.name: FUFIRE_REQUIRE_EXPLICIT_ENV
variables.description: Truthy in every container image: refuses to start when FUFIRE_ENV is unset.

variables.name: FUFIRE_REQUIRE_API_KEYS
variables.description: Forces API-key enforcement. Production must set it truthy; the dev-mode bypass is then unreachable.

variables.name: FUFIRE_API_KEYS
variables.description: Comma-separated static API keys. Credential material: never echoed. A configured KeyStore backend satisfies the production requirement instead.

variables.name: KEY_STORE_BACKEND
variables.description: Selects the pluggable store for runtime-minted keys. Unsupported values raise instead of falling back.

variables.name: FUFIRE_KEY_TIER_OVERRIDES
variables.description: Comma-separated key:tier pairs. Contains key material on the left-hand side, so it is treated as a secret.

variables.name: FUFIRE_ADMIN_TOKEN
variables.description: Bearer token for the admin key-issuance surface. Gated additionally by the key_issuance feature flag.

variables.name: ELEVENLABS_TOOL_SECRET
variables.description: HMAC shared secret for the internal ElevenLabs webhook.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_HMAC_ONLY
variables.description: Restricts webhook authentication to HMAC, disabling the API-key fallback.

variables.name: SUPERGLUE_API_KEY
variables.description: Upstream credential for the legacy Superglue proxy surface.

variables.name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Explicit origin allowlist. Production rejects a wildcard and any local origin.

variables.name: FUFIRE_REPLICA_COUNT
variables.description: Declared replica count. Drives the shared-counter and Redis requirements.

variables.name: FUFIRE_REQUIRE_REDIS
variables.description: Forces Redis-backed limiter storage regardless of replica count.

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.description: Primary limiter storage connection URI. Carries credentials, so it is never echoed.

variables.name: REDIS_PRIVATE_URL
variables.description: Secondary limiter storage connection URI, resolved after REDIS_URL. Carries credentials.

variables.name: FUFIRE_RL_PEPPER
variables.description: Operator-supplied pepper for the shared limiter's pseudonymous identities. Separate from every API key, the admin token and the webhook secret. Must be stable across replicas and restarts whenever limiter counters outlive a single process; a process-local value would shard every shared counter. Never logged and never echoed.

variables.name: FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS
variables.description: Uvicorn's trusted forwarded-header peer allowlist. This contract does NOT set or widen it: unset keeps Uvicorn's own loopback-only default. Production rejects a wildcard unconditionally, and any non-default value requires a recorded runtime-evidence reference. The concrete ingress binding is owned by the runtime-evidence subtask and is not asserted here.

variables.name: FUFIRE_TRUSTED_PROXY_EVIDENCE_ID
variables.description: Reference to the recorded ingress evidence that justifies a non-default FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS allowlist. Never satisfies a wildcard.

variables.name: EPHEMERIS_MODE
variables.description: Swiss Ephemeris backend selector. Production permits SWIEPH only.

variables.name: SE_EPHE_PATH
variables.description: Filesystem location of the SE1 ephemeris files. Reported as present/absent only; a host path is an infrastructure detail.

variables.name: FUFIRE_MOSEPH_ATTESTATION_ENFORCE
variables.description: Enforces the Moshier attestation check outside the production profile.

variables.name: FUFIRE_ENABLE_KEY_ISSUANCE
variables.description: Engine-side key issuance. Forbidden in production; the durable BFF plane owns issuance.

variables.name: FUFIRE_ENABLE_ZWDS
variables.description: Exposes the ZWDS surface. Production additionally requires an explicit sign-off id.

variables.name: FUFIRE_ZWDS_SIGNOFF_ID
variables.description: Release sign-off reference required before ZWDS may be enabled in production.

variables.name: FUFIRE_ENABLE_HEHUN_MARKETING
variables.description: Hehun marketing surface. Remains disabled in production pending release approval.

variables.name: FUFIRE_BAZI_PRECISION_V2_DEFAULT
variables.description: Switches BaZi Precision V2 on as the default. Forbidden in production.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Listening port for the ASGI server entry point.

variables.name: BUILD_VERSION
variables.description: Overrides the reported build version. Defaults to the engine build label.

variables.name: EXPOSE_BUILD_METADATA
variables.description: Enables deploy-identity fields on the public build endpoint.

variables.name: FUFIRE_BUILD_PROVIDER
variables.description: Provider-neutral name of the platform that produced this running candidate.

variables.name: FUFIRE_BUILD_COMMIT_SHA
variables.description: Provider-neutral commit/revision identity of the running candidate.

variables.name: FUFIRE_BUILD_RELEASE_ID
variables.description: Provider-neutral deployment/release identity of the running candidate.

variables.name: FUFIRE_BUILD_IMAGE_REF
variables.description: Provider-neutral image reference of the running candidate.

variables.name: RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA
variables.description: Railway-supplied commit identity. Retained as an alternative provider binding.

variables.name: RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_ID
variables.description: Railway-supplied deployment identity. Retained as an alternative provider binding.

variables.name: FLY_ALLOC_ID
variables.description: Historical Fly.io allocation identity. Decommissioned provider, retained for response-shape compatibility.

variables.name: FLY_REGION
variables.description: Historical Fly.io region identity. Decommissioned provider, retained for response-shape compatibility.
